title: Numbers Bible Quiz - Chapter 20
description: Ten questions on Numbers 20: Miriam's death, the waters of Meribah, Edom's refusal and the death of Aaron on Mount Hor.

questions.text: Who died and was buried at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin?
questions.explanation: The congregation came into the wilderness of Zin and stayed in Kadesh; Miriam died there and was buried there.

questions.text: Why did the congregation assemble against Moses and Aaron at Kadesh?
questions.explanation: There was no water for the congregation, so they assembled themselves together against Moses and Aaron.

questions.text: What did Yahweh tell Moses and Aaron to do to the rock?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told them to assemble the congregation and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it would pour out its water.

answers.text: Speak to it before the people's eyes
Strike it twice with the rod
Pour oil on it as an offering
Build an altar beside it first

questions.text: What did Moses call the assembly gathered before the rock?
questions.explanation: Moses said to them, "Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?"

questions.text: How many times did Moses strike the rock with his rod?
questions.explanation: Moses lifted up his hand and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly.

questions.text: What consequence did Yahweh announce to Moses and Aaron because they did not believe in him?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that, because they did not believe in him to sanctify him, they would not bring this assembly into the land he had given them.

answers.text: They would not bring the assembly into the land
They would wander alone for forty days
Their sons would lose the priesthood

questions.text: What name is given to these waters?
questions.explanation: "These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with Yahweh."

questions.text: In the message asking to pass through the land, which road did they promise to go along?
questions.explanation: The message said, "We will go along the king's highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left."

answers.text: The way of the Red Sea

questions.text: On Mount Hor, Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on whom?
questions.explanation: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments and put them on Eleazar his son, and Aaron died there on the top of the mountain.

questions.text: How long did the house of Israel weep for Aaron?
questions.explanation: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days.
